name: Rustic Montana Furniture
old_description: Your source for authentic, elegantly western furniture.  Made in Montana, you can be assured each piece is created to last a lifetime.  All of our beds are true mortise and tenon construction.   Transform your home with handcrafted authentic western beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, and benches.  Created from barnwood or log, each are handcrafted with form and function in mind.  Our dining tables are all one-of-a-kind created with reclaimed lumber.  For your outdoor space we have rustic swings for two.  Rustic Montana Furniture is certified “Made in Montana”.
about:
Rustic Montana Furniture operates from Philipsburg, Montana, where it has been producing handcrafted western furniture for over two decades. The business is led by Walter Stanghill, who serves as the primary contact for the company. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm emphasizes its Montana roots and a commitment to traditional joinery.

The company designs and builds a range of authentic western furniture, including beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, benches, and outdoor swings. All beds feature true mortise-and-tenon construction, and each piece is handcrafted from either barnwood or log materials. Dining tables are made from reclaimed lumber, resulting in one-of-a-kind surfaces. Production takes place entirely in Montana, though the facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

The company serves residential customers seeking elegantly western furnishings, though specific industry segments or commercial clients are not detailed in its public materials. Its certified "Made in Montana" designation underscores a local manufacturing focus.

Rustic Montana Furniture distinguishes itself through its certified "Made in Montana" status, the use of mortise-and-tenon joinery on all beds, and the creation of unique dining tables from reclaimed lumber. The firm states that each piece is created to last a lifetime, reflecting a philosophy of durability and authentic craftsmanship.

name: S and Y Industries, Inc.
old_description: Located in Winfield, Kansas, S and Y Industries has been one of America’s premier providers of custom electronics engineering, manufacturing and turnkey assembly services since 1984. As a family-owned, ISO-certified precision manufacturer, we strive to deliver unparalleled production consistency and efficiency with all of our premium electronics solutions.
about:
S and Y Industries is based in Winfield, Kansas. The company was founded in 1984 by Sandy Foust on the back porch of a farmhouse in Atlanta, Kansas. It remains family-owned and woman-owned, with Sandy Foust serving as CEO and her sons Dan and John Foust overseeing production and sales.

The company provides custom electronic contract manufacturing services, including printed circuit board (PCB) assembly with surface mount technology (SMT) and thru-hole processes, wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box builds, product testing, engineering and design, and program management. Operations are housed in a 60,000-square-foot facility staffed by over 100 employees, supporting low- to mid-volume production runs.

S and Y serves customers in medical, aerospace, commercial, and industrial manufacturing sectors. Its client base includes companies requiring ITAR-compliant defense work and ISO 13485-certified medical device production.

The company emphasizes a family-like culture and a commitment to acting as an extension of its customers' operations, with a stated philosophy of delivering what customers want, when they want it. Certifications such as AS9100D, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485, and in-house IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 qualified personnel underpin its quality focus.

name: S&F Foods, Inc.
old_description: Manufacturing for institutional school foodservice programs and retail since 2003.
about:
S&F Foods, Inc. is a frozen food manufacturer headquartered in Romulus, Michigan, founded in 2003. The company specializes in producing enrobed and topped items for institutional school foodservice programs and retail markets nationwide.

The company operates a 37,000-square-foot facility capable of high- and low-volume production. Its enrobed line fills and par-bakes hand-held pocket items, mixes hot or cold sauces, and individually quick-freezes (IQF) products with multiple packing options including printed film, retail boxes, and cartons. A topped line handles crusts of any size with similar sauce mixing and IQF capabilities. S&F also runs a dedicated gluten-free line with segregated storage, certified suppliers, and in-house and external allergen testing. Product offerings include the Original Pull-A-Part Topped Breadsticks and Dave’s Detroit Style Pizza, and the firm processes USDA commodities such as cheese, tomato paste, and flour.

S&F Foods serves institutional school foodservice programs, including the National School Lunch Program, and retail channels nationwide. Its products are distributed to schools and retail outlets across the country.

The company emphasizes food safety and quality, holding BRCGS AA Grade certification, USDA compliance, gluten-free certification from GFCO, and organic certification from Global Organic Alliance. Its mission highlights decades of experience producing safe, certified, and authentic products with ongoing reviews of food safety policies.

name: S&W Foods
old_description: S&W Wholesale was founded in 1978 by Frank & Rosemary Spalitta, lifelong residents of Hammond, Louisiana. They began with a passion for serving local foodservice operators throughout Tangipahoa Parish. Today their son, Paul, continues to grow and build on their legacy by servicing throughout all of Southeast Louisiana and the Mississippi Gulfcoast.
about:
S&W Foods operates from Hammond, Louisiana, where it was founded in 1978 by Frank and Rosemary Spalitta. The family-owned business began by serving foodservice operators throughout Tangipahoa Parish and has since expanded across Southeast Louisiana and the Mississippi Gulf Coast under the leadership of their son, Paul Spalitta, who now serves as president and owner.

The company functions as a broadline distributor, offering a vast selection of food and non‑food items that includes produce, meats, breads, condiments, equipment, smallwares, paper goods, and cleaning supplies. Its distribution facility sits near the I‑55/I‑12 corridor, enabling rapid delivery — notably remaining operational the day after Hurricanes Ida and Katrina. S&W also develops private‑label brands such as Copper Creek Cattle Company and Captain Frank’s Seafood, and runs special programs for custom‑cut steaks, fresh produce through Fresh Concepts, and artisanal cheeses via The Rind Cheese Company.

S&W serves a wide range of restaurant types, from donut shops and coffee shops to Tex‑Mex, Italian, Mediterranean, family dining, sandwich shops, and seafood establishments. Its customer base includes both independent operators and chain accounts, all supported by the company’s independent structure and partnerships with major suppliers like Unipro Foodservice, Campbell Foodservice, ConAgra Foodservice, Rich Products, Pillsbury, Hormel, General Mills, and Smithfield Foods.

The company’s guiding principle, coined by the founder, is "Large enough to serve, small enough to care." This philosophy drives its emphasis on personal relationships, quick reaction to customer needs without corporate red tape, and a commitment to helping operators grow their businesses. The combination of local ownership, disaster‑ready logistics, and curated product programs sets S&W apart in the regional foodservice market.

name: SAI Advanced Power Solutions
old_description: Introducing Profusion™ - a revolutionary all-in-one PDU platform with one of the best industry lead times, quality, and performance. It features a sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and power distribution cabinet with advanced metering and monitoring, accessible locally and remotely.
about:
SAI Advanced Power Solutions is headquartered in Franklin Park, Illinois, with additional campuses in St. Charles and a distribution center in Carol Stream. The company operates as an end-to-end manufacturer of advanced power distribution solutions.

The company designs and manufactures low-voltage switchgear (UL 1558, UL 891), medium-voltage switchgear (5 kV–38 kV), DC switchgear, custom power distribution units (PDUs), and proprietary platforms such as Profusion™—an all-in-one PDU with sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and integrated metering—and EVention™, a BABA-compliant power distribution platform for EV charging. Services span engineering design, system optimization, startup and commissioning, field measurement and retrofit, preventative maintenance, training, and power-quality monitoring. A new production center, three times the size of the previous facility, supports both custom and high-volume production.

SAI serves telecommunications, renewable energy integration, hydrogen generation, battery energy storage, and energy consulting sectors. Its market-focused business units target mission-critical facilities, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), commercial/industrial/government clients, emerging markets, and aftermarket support.

The company emphasizes “future-ready” innovation, citing patented products, a Teaming for Customer Success (TCS) program, and a supply-chain transformation that expanded manufacturing capacity.

name: SFS Fabrication
old_description: Specialty Fabrication Services is a family owned and operated full-service metal fabrication shop built upon the aptitude of motivated people who believe that teamwork and continuous improvement is essential to providing quality products and services for our valued customers.
about:
Specialty Fabrication Services, operating as SFS Fabrication, is a family-owned metal fabrication shop based in Taylor, Michigan. The company describes itself as a full-service shop built on teamwork and continuous improvement, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, mild steel, and cast iron, offering capabilities that include tubular and sheet metal fabrication, TIG/MIG/soldering welding, shearing up to 1/4-inch thick by 4-foot wide, press brake forming from 24 gauge to 1 inch, roll forming of cones up to 20-inch OD, tube forming, custom exhaust work, and sheet metal stamping. Equipment on the floor includes a 10-foot press brake, a 10-foot hydraulic shear, a 200-ton hydraulic four-post press, Huth tubing expander and bender, 4-foot power slip rolls, Bridgeport mills, lathes, bandsaws, and cold saws. The business handles projects ranging from prototype development to full production runs.

Customers span industrial, manufacturing, medical, food processing, residential/commercial, automotive, and crematorium sectors. Concrete examples of past work include catwalks, pergolas, decorative balconies, catalyst canning systems, entrance overhangs, production brackets, riser assemblies, food-grade conveyors, and crematorium supplies.

The company states that its differentiators rest on high standards of integrity, ethical business practices, quality, competitiveness, and responsiveness, aiming to build long-term partnerships through fair pricing and a safe, respectful workplace.

name: SMC Electrical Products
old_description: Becker/SMC was originally established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. From the beginning, Becker/SMC focused on quality products and service to meet customers’ needs. Becker/SMC designs and manufactures electrical components, open-type and explosion proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls and power distribution equipment for a variety of industries.
about:
Becker/SMC was established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. The company began with a focus on quality electrical products and service to meet customer needs.

Today, Becker/SMC designs and manufactures a range of electrical components including open-type and explosion-proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls, and power distribution equipment. Operating from a 90,000-square-foot facility in Bristol, Virginia, the company has expanded through seven major facility expansions and several acquisitions that added transformers, distribution equipment, vacuum switches, connectors, and electronic monitoring devices. Its Custom Equipment Operation uses parametric engineering and lean manufacturing to turn customer specifications into precision products.

The company serves a variety of industries, with a notable presence in the transit sector following the acquisition of OB Systems, a firm with 20 years of experience supplying electrical substations, rectifiers, AC and DC switchgear, traction power substations, and related hardware to heavy and light rail systems across North America. Its longwall controls also serve mining operations.

Becker/SMC emphasizes that its growth stems from developing major innovations and specialized electrical components in-house, backed by strict quality assurance processes that ensure products meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

name: SPI Solar Panel Installation NC
old_description: We have helped hundreds of North Carolina homeowners cut their energy bills and protect their homes with professional solar installations and roofing built to last. Certified experts, transparent pricing, and a guarantee that protects your investment for 25 years.
about:
SPI Solar Panel Installation NC operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, as a locally owned and operated solar and roofing contractor serving homeowners across the state. The company was founded after its owners observed that out-of-state firms were making promises to North Carolina residents, sending subcontractors, and then disappearing once the job was done. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the company reports over a decade of local experience.

The firm provides residential rooftop solar panel installation, solar panel repair, full roof installation, roof repair and replacement, roof inspection, home energy system monitoring, solar heat pump installation, home battery installation, Level 2 EV charger installation, home insulation and sealing, and solar shade installation. All work is performed by the company's own certified local team with no subcontractors. Installations are backed by a 25-year performance guarantee. The physical installation typically takes one to two days, while the full process from assessment to a live system runs four to eight weeks including permitting and utility approval.

The company serves residential homeowners throughout North Carolina, designing systems around each home's energy usage, roof condition, and budget. Its installations have collectively produced 25 million kilowatt-hours of clean solar energy, eliminating over 2,000 tons of CO2 annually — equivalent to 33,000 trees worth of carbon capture.

The business was started to offer a better alternative to the transient, subcontractor-driven model the founders encountered. It emphasizes local knowledge of North Carolina's climate, utility infrastructure, permit requirements, and available incentives, along with transparent pricing and dedicated aftercare support.
